Base fragment of Roman samian ware vessel with makers stamp in the center, c.AD1st-3rd Century. Sherd contains the foot and part of the base of a Samian vessel, probably a small bowl, there is a makers stamp in the interior base of the object that lists FESTVSF as the maker, this is in a cartouche within a ring.
